name: Lumen
source:
Age: Appears as 15
Specialization: None
Main Element: Water
Secondary Element: Fire
History: While it has been some time since she come to Astral she still can't remember anything from her past
lives and she can't get a hang of even basic magic, to the point some wonder if she is really worthy of being in Astral.
Because of this Lumen lucks confidence and has become a lot quieter than she used to be.
Most other people in Astral don't pay her much attention but there are several exceptions, her best friend
Iori that is always trying to cheer her up, her other friend and Iori's Girlfriend Nene, and also for some reason
an elite witch of their grade Diane that is trying to help Lumen from time to time. While Lumen is grateful for it she
also worries about why would someone like her pay her attention. There is also a mysterious half cat Mao that speaks to her
sometimes.
Personality: While she used to be a very positive and optimistic person her constant failures since coming
in Astral have changed her and made her more quiet and shy, whoever sometimes when spending times
with friends her optimistic side still shows up. Still not the one for giving up and is trying hard
to improve, true she (unsuccessfully) tries to hide it in order not to worry her friends as she often pushes herself
past her own limits. She is very emotional and caring and likes to help others if she can.
